user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's birthday. Can you help me find a list of short URLs to send out the party invitations? Also, I need some creative and funny messages to include in the invitations. And finally, I want to check the availability of different languages for the invitations.

TaskList.description: Generate a list of short URLs for the party invitations.
Create a collection of creative and funny messages for the invitations.
Check the availability of different language options for the invitations.
